scope: Vector builder/reviewer V1/V2 and intermediate attempt evidence only; no new tests, model edits, Git, native or shared-file changes.
method: Hash inventory of exact existing bytes; reuse matching files already under iteration11; copy only absent content hashes into content-addressed objects. Originals never moved/rewritten. Byte hashes and lengths checked after each copy; original inventory rechecked after pass.
unavailability_explanation: An unavailable row means no exact byte sequence matching that historical receipt input digest was found in the current model, preserved69/76/module-target/V1 snapshots, builder control snapshots/run logs, explicit binding-attempt copies, or exact V1/V2 reviewer scratch trees. Earlier live candidate files were edited before a full source snapshot was saved. Their original receipt/input digest and raw diagnostics remain preserved, but later files are not substituted and original source is not invented from diagnostics. Environment providers (pinned Verus executable, Python executable/sitepackages) are named/versioned by receipts, not newly copied source artifacts. Root will additionally archive whole .g5; this manifest does not claim missing bytes were recovered.
verification: All original inventoried files and all listed already-present reviewer files retained their initial SHA256 after the preservation pass.
